description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the ProjectRestEndpoint class, testing CRUD operations on projects via REST API endpoints.

classes.name: ProjectRestEndpointUTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ProjectRestEndpoint, testing its REST API methods for project management.

methods.name: testCreateProject
methods.description: Tests creating a new project via the createProject REST endpoint, verifying HTTP OK response.

methods.name: testGetProject
methods.description: Tests retrieving a project by ID, verifying that the correct ProjectResource is returned.

methods.name: testDeleteProject
methods.description: Tests deleting a project by ID, verifying that the delete method is called exactly once.

methods.name: testUpdateProject
methods.description: Tests updating a project via the updateProject endpoint, verifying HTTP OK response.
